explanation: Keep a fixed 111-entry frequency table, running sum/count and cached extrema/mode. Each insertion updates these constant-size statistics.
correctness: The frequency table counts every insertion. Extrema are updated against every new value; sum/count define the mean; updating the mode on a new largest frequency preserves a maximizing value.
walkthrough: Insert 4, 10 and 4. The minimum is 4, maximum 10, sum 18 and count 3, so the mean is 6. Frequency 4 is 2 while frequency 10 is 1, so GetMode returns 4. Repeating getters does not consume any reading. JSON supplies [operationNames,argumentLists] for one fresh TempTracker. Insert displays null; empty getters return null, means allow 1e-9 tolerance and any maximizing mode is valid.
edgeCases: Empty getters return null. With readings 3 and 8, either mode is accepted; means use floating-point division and getters do not consume readings.
timeComplexity: O(1) per insertion/getter: insertion changes one frequency bucket and a fixed number of cached statistics; getters read cached values.
spaceComplexity: O(1) persistent space: exactly 111 frequency slots plus count, sum, extrema and mode, independent of reading count.
